title: Elio Mortgage launches with $5.1m in pre-seed funding
summary: AI-native startup Elio Mortgage has raised $5.1 million in pre-seed funding led by Motive Partners and Social Leverage.
content: AI-native startup Elio Mortgage has officially launched after securing $5.1 million in a pre-seed funding round. The investment was co-led by Motive Partners and Social Leverage. The newly acquired capital will be used to support the company's growth and development as it enters the mortgage market with its innovative technology.
content_ta: AI-native startup ஆன Elio Mortgage, pre-seed funding சுற்றில் $5.1 மில்லியன் நிதியைத் திரட்டி அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாகத் தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. Motive Partners மற்றும் Social Leverage ஆகியவை இந்த முதலீட்டுக்குத் தலைமை தாங்கின. இப்புதிய நிதி நிறுவனத்தின் வளர்ச்சிக்கும், தொழில்நுட்ப மேம்பாட்டிற்கும் பயன்படுத்தப்படும்.

title: Circle and Volante partner to help banks integrate stablecoins into payment operations
summary: Payments-as-a-Service specialist Volante Technologies is working with USDC-issuer Circle to  help financial institutions integrate stablecoin payment and settlement capabilities into their existing operations.
content: Payments-as-a-Service provider Volante Technologies has entered a strategic partnership with USDC-issuer Circle. The collaboration aims to enable financial institutions to integrate stablecoin payment and settlement capabilities directly into their current operational frameworks. By leveraging Volante's existing infrastructure, banks can simplify the process of adopting USDC, making it easier for traditional financial organizations to support digital asset transactions within their day-to-day operations.
content_ta: Payments-as-a-Service நிறுவனமான Volante Technologies, USDC-ஐ வழங்கும் நிறுவனமான Circle-உடன் ஒரு முக்கிய கூட்டாண்மையை மேற்கொண்டுள்ளது. வங்கிகள் தங்கள் தற்போதைய செயல்பாடுகளில் USDC stablecoin செலுத்துதல் மற்றும் தீர்வு காணும் வசதிகளை எளிதாக ஒருங்கிணைக்க இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு உதவுகிறது. Volante-இன் தொழில்நுட்ப உள்கட்டமைப்பைப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம், பாரம்பரிய நிதி நிறுவனங்கள் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து பரிவர்த்தனைகளை தங்கள் அன்றாட வங்கிச் சேவைகளில் எளிதாக இணைக்க முடியும்.

title: SMEs turn from banks to fintechs for cross-border payments
summary: Most small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) trading internationally are set to switch their current cross-border payment provider in the next two years, according to a Mastercard report.
content: A Mastercard report reveals that many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) conducting international trade plan to move away from traditional banks for cross-border payments. These businesses are increasingly seeking alternatives offered by fintech companies to handle their global transactions. The shift is expected to occur over the next two years as SMEs look for more efficient ways to manage their international financial operations and overcome current banking limitations.
content_ta: சர்வதேச அளவில் வர்த்தகம் செய்யும் சிறு மற்றும் குறு நிறுவனங்கள் (SMEs), தங்கள் எல்லை தாண்டிய பணப் பரிவர்த்தனைகளுக்கு பாரம்பரிய வங்கிகளை விடுத்து, நிதி தொழில்நுட்ப (fintech) நிறுவனங்களை நோக்கி மாறிவருவதாக Mastercard அறிக்கை ஒன்று தெரிவிக்கிறது. அடுத்த இரண்டு ஆண்டுகளுக்குள் பெரும்பாலான நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் பணப் பரிவர்த்தனை சேவை வழங்குநர்களை மாற்றத் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளன. உலகளாவிய வர்த்தகத்தை எளிதாக்கவும், வங்கிகளின் தற்போதைய நடைமுறைகளைத் தவிர்க்கவும் இந்த மாற்றத்தை நிறுவனங்கள் மேற்கொண்டு வருகின்றன.

title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
summary: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.
content: A new voluntary accord established under the Trump administration outlines a framework for leading technology companies to self-police their own frontier artificial intelligence models. Rather than relying on strict government mandates, the agreement places the primary responsibility for managing and mitigating advanced AI risks directly upon the developers and creators of these powerful technologies.
content_ta: Trump நிர்வாகத்தின் கீழ் உருவாக்கப்பட்டுள்ள புதிய சுய விருப்ப ஒப்பந்தமானது, முன்னணி tech நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் சொந்த frontier AI மாடல்களைத் தாங்களே கட்டுப்படுத்த வழிவகை செய்கிறது. கடுமையான அரசு விதிமுறைகளை நம்பியிராமல், மேம்பட்ட AI அபாயங்களை நிர்வகிக்கும் பொறுப்பை இந்த ஒப்பந்தம் நேரடியாக டெவலப்பர்களிடமே வழங்குகிறது.

title: Sentora split 50% Aave revenue, but suppliers absorb all losses
summary:
The DAO would keep the contracts, but Sentora would set market risk controls and suppliers have no specified loss cushion in the plan.
The post Sentora split 50% Aave revenue, but suppliers absorb all losses appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A proposal for a revenue-sharing model between Aave and Sentora suggests a 50% split of earnings. Under this plan, the DAO would retain control of the contracts, while Sentora would manage market risk controls. However, concerns have been raised as the current structure indicates that suppliers would be responsible for absorbing all potential losses, with no specified risk mitigation or cushions included in the proposal.
content_ta: Aave மற்றும் Sentora இடையே வருவாயைப் பகிர்ந்து கொள்ளும் புதிய முன்மொழிவு ஒன்று முன்வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதன்படி வருவாயில் 50% இரு தரப்பும் பகிர்ந்து கொள்ளும். DAO ஒப்பந்தங்களைக் கட்டுப்பாட்டில் வைத்திருக்கும் அதே வேளையில், சந்தை இடர் மேலாண்மையை Sentora கவனிக்கும். எனினும், இந்தத் திட்டத்தில் ஏதேனும் இழப்பு ஏற்பட்டால், அதற்கான இழப்பீட்டு பாதுகாப்பு ஏதுமின்றி, சப்ளையர்களே முழு இழப்பையும் ஏற்க வேண்டும் என்பது குறிப்பிடத்தக்கது.

title: Binance Starts Moving Crypto Out Of Funding Accounts Ahead Of Stocks Rename
summary: Binance has begun migrating non-stock crypto assets from Funding Accounts into Spot Accounts. The migration starts September 29 and is expected to continue in stages through January 2027. Funding Accounts will eventually be renamed Stocks Accounts and used primarily for stock and stock-option settlement.
content: Binance has officially begun the migration of non-stock cryptocurrency assets from Funding Accounts into Spot Accounts. This transition, which commences on September 29, is scheduled to take place in stages over the coming months, concluding in January 2027. Following this process, the exchange plans to rename its Funding Accounts to Stocks Accounts, repurposing them specifically for the settlement of stock and stock-option products for its global user base.
content_ta: Binance தனது Funding Accounts-ல் உள்ள கிரிப்டோ சொத்துக்களை Spot Accounts-க்கு மாற்றும் நடவடிக்கையைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. செப்டம்பர் 29 அன்று தொடங்கும் இந்த மாற்றம், படிப்படியாக நடைபெற்று ஜனவரி 2027-க்குள் நிறைவடையும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது. இந்த மாற்றத்திற்குப் பிறகு, Funding Accounts என்பது Stocks Accounts என பெயர் மாற்றம் செய்யப்படவுள்ளது. இந்த கணக்குகள் இனி பங்குச்சந்தை மற்றும் பங்கு சார்ந்த வர்த்தக நடவடிக்கைகளுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக பயன்படுத்தப்படும்.

title: Jim Cramer Says the AI Trade's Real Threat Is the Story, Not the Spend
summary:
Jim Cramer says the AI trade faces a narrative problem, not a spending one, as Treasury yields climb to a 24-year high.
The post Jim Cramer Says the AI Trade's Real Threat Is the Story, Not the Spend appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Jim Cramer warns that the primary risk to the artificial intelligence investment trend is not corporate spending, but the prevailing market narrative. As Treasury yields reach a 24-year high, investors are increasingly cautious. Cramer suggests that market sentiment and the way the industry's story is framed will determine the future direction of these AI-related stocks, despite the significant capital expenditures currently being made by major technology companies.
content_ta: செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) முதலீட்டுப் போக்கிற்குப் பெருநிறுவனங்களின் செலவுகளை விட, தற்போதைய சந்தை விவரிப்பே (market narrative) பெரிய அச்சுறுத்தலாக இருப்பதாக Jim Cramer எச்சரித்துள்ளார். Treasury வட்டி விகிதங்கள் 24 ஆண்டுகளில் இல்லாத உச்சத்தை எட்டியுள்ள நிலையில், முதலீட்டாளர்கள் எச்சரிக்கையுடன் உள்ளனர். தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் அதிக முதலீடு செய்தாலும், சந்தையின் மனநிலை மற்றும் இந்தத் துறையின் கதைக்களம் எப்படி வடிவமைக்கப்படுகிறது என்பதே AI பங்குகளின் எதிர்காலத்தைத் தீர்மானிக்கும் என்று அவர் கூறுகிறார்.

title: Trump Leaves AI Safety to Tech Giants: Inside the New AI Accord
summary:
Trump's AI accord asks Google, Meta, and OpenAI to police themselves. See what it requires and why it may lack teeth.
The post Trump Leaves AI Safety to Tech Giants: Inside the New AI Accord appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: President Donald Trump has introduced a new AI policy framework that relies on major technology companies to regulate their own safety standards. Under this agreement, firms like Google, Meta, and OpenAI are expected to monitor their platforms autonomously. Critics suggest that without strict federal oversight, the accord may lack the necessary enforcement mechanisms to ensure consistent safety protocols across the rapidly evolving artificial intelligence industry.
content_ta: President Donald Trump ஒரு புதிய AI கொள்கை கட்டமைப்பை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளார். இது பெரிய தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் சொந்த பாதுகாப்பு தரநிலைகளை தாங்களே ஒழுங்குபடுத்திக்கொள்ள வழிவகுக்கிறது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின் கீழ், Google, Meta மற்றும் OpenAI போன்ற நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் தளங்களை சுயமாகக் கண்காணிக்க எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றன. முறையான அரசு மேற்பார்வை இல்லாததால், இந்த ஒப்பந்தம் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுத் துறையில் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்ய போதுமானதாக இருக்காது என்று விமர்சகர்கள் கருதுகின்றனர்.

title: Kalshi ends volume incentive program effective October 13
summary:
Kalshi's program termination may reduce trading incentives, potentially impacting market liquidity and pricing efficiency in prediction markets.
The post Kalshi ends volume incentive program effective October 13 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Kalshi has announced the termination of its volume incentive program, effective October 13. This move marks a strategic shift for the prediction market platform, potentially impacting market liquidity and trading behaviors. By discontinuing these financial rewards for high-volume participants, the platform may see adjustments in its overall pricing efficiency. The decision was confirmed following an initial report by Crypto Briefing.
content_ta: Kalshi தனது வால்யூம் இன்சென்டிவ் (volume incentive) திட்டத்தை அக்டோபர் 13 முதல் முடிவுக்கு கொண்டு வருவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த முடிவு, பிளாட்ஃபார்மின் வர்த்தக நடவடிக்கைகள் மற்றும் சந்தை பணப்புழக்கத்தில் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது. அதிக வர்த்தகம் செய்யும் பயனர்களுக்கான சலுகைகளை ரத்து செய்வதன் மூலம், சந்தையில் விலை நிர்ணய முறையில் மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்பட வாய்ப்புள்ளது என Crypto Briefing அறிக்கை தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Robinhood launches 10x leveraged crypto trading for US users
summary:
Robinhood's leveraged crypto trading could amplify market volatility and risk, potentially impacting inexperienced traders and regulatory scrutiny.
The post Robinhood launches 10x leveraged crypto trading for US users appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Robinhood has introduced 10x leveraged cryptocurrency trading for its users in the United States. This expansion allows traders to significantly increase their market positions using borrowed capital. However, industry analysts warn that such high-leverage products may introduce substantial financial risks and increased market volatility, particularly for inexperienced investors. The move also highlights the potential for heightened regulatory oversight regarding leveraged crypto trading products within the American market.
content_ta: Robinhood நிறுவனம் அமெரிக்க பயனர்களுக்காக 10x லிவரேஜ் (leveraged) கிரிப்டோ வர்த்தக வசதியை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய வசதி முதலீட்டாளர்கள் கடன் வாங்கிய மூலதனத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி வர்த்தக நிலைகளை அதிகரிக்க அனுமதிக்கிறது. இருப்பினும், அதிகப்படியான லிவரேஜ் கொண்ட தயாரிப்புகள் சந்தையில் அதிக ஏற்ற இறக்கங்களை உருவாக்கக்கூடும் என்றும், அனுபவமற்ற முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு இது அதிக நிதி அபாயங்களை ஏற்படுத்தும் என்றும் நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். இந்த நடவடிக்கையால் அமெரிக்காவில் கிரிப்டோ வர்த்தகத்திற்கான ஒழுங்குமுறை நடவடிக்கைகள் அதிகரிக்க வாய்ப்புள்ளது.

title: Bain Capital bids to acquire Koch’s data center company in deal exceeding $15 billion
summary:
Bain's acquisition of Edged could accelerate sustainable data center practices, influencing industry standards amid growing environmental concerns.
The post Bain Capital bids to acquire Koch’s data center company in deal exceeding $15 billion appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Bain Capital has launched a bid to acquire Edged, the data center company owned by Koch Industries. The proposed deal is valued at more than $15 billion. This significant acquisition could allow Bain Capital to play a more central role in the infrastructure sector, potentially setting new sustainability benchmarks for data centers as environmental concerns continue to impact the industry’s development and operational standards globally.
content_ta: Koch Industries நிறுவனத்திற்குச் சொந்தமான Edged தரவு மையத்தை வாங்குவதற்கு Bain Capital நிறுவனம் முயற்சி மேற்கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின் மதிப்பு $15 பில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமாக இருக்கும் எனக் கூறப்படுகிறது. இந்த கையகப்படுத்தல் மூலம், தரவு மையங்களின் செயல்பாட்டில் சுற்றுச்சூழல் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்ய Bain Capital நிறுவனம் முக்கிய பங்காற்றக்கூடும். இது தரவு மையத் துறையில் புதிய நிலையான தரநிலைகளை உருவாக்க உதவும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: At least one sovereign wealth fund sells gold to buy Bitcoin, Bitwise reports
summary:
The shift from gold to Bitcoin by a sovereign wealth fund signals growing institutional confidence in crypto as a reserve asset alternative.
The post At least one sovereign wealth fund sells gold to buy Bitcoin, Bitwise reports appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A report from Bitwise indicates that at least one sovereign wealth fund has begun reallocating its reserves by selling gold to purchase Bitcoin. This move highlights a significant shift in institutional investment strategy, reflecting growing confidence in digital assets as a viable alternative to precious metals. The development suggests that state-level entities are increasingly viewing Bitcoin as a legitimate reserve asset for long-term portfolio diversification.
content_ta: Bitwise வெளியிட்ட அறிக்கையின்படி, ஒரு இறையாண்மை கொண்ட முதலீட்டு நிதியம் (sovereign wealth fund) தனது தங்க இருப்புக்களை விற்றுவிட்டு Bitcoin-ஐ வாங்கியுள்ளது. நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்கள் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களை ஒரு பாதுகாப்பான மாற்று முதலீடாகப் பார்க்கத் தொடங்கியுள்ளதை இந்த நடவடிக்கை காட்டுகிறது. நீண்டகால முதலீட்டுத் திட்டங்களுக்காக நாடுகள் Bitcoin-ஐ ஒரு முக்கிய சொத்தாகக் கருதத் தொடங்கியுள்ளன என்பதை இந்த மாற்றம் உணர்த்துகிறது.

content_ta: Binance நிறுவனம் HYPE டோக்கனை ஸ்பாட் வர்த்தகத்திற்காகப் பட்டியலிட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நிகழ்வானது, டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துத் துறையின் வளர்ச்சி குறித்த Binance நிறுவனர் CZ-ன் கருத்துக்களுடன் இணைந்துள்ளது. முன்னணி வர்த்தக தளத்தில் இந்த டோக்கன் சேர்க்கப்பட்டிருப்பது, பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட திட்டங்கள் பிரதான வர்த்தகச் சூழலில் ஒருங்கிணைக்கப்படுவதையும், உலகளாவிய கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சந்தை முதிர்ச்சியடைவதையும் காட்டுகிறது.

title: E-Invoicing in the Middle East: More Than a Compliance Exercise

Sudheer Padiyar of SunTec Business Solutions explains why the Middle East's shift to e-invoicing is a transformation story, not a compliance chore.

content: Middle Eastern nations are rapidly adopting e-invoicing systems to modernize their economies. Sudheer Padiyar of SunTec Business Solutions notes that this transition represents a significant digital transformation rather than a simple regulatory compliance requirement. By digitizing billing processes, businesses in the region are gaining greater operational efficiency, improved financial transparency, and better integration into the global digital economy, marking a strategic shift for the entire Middle East.
content_ta: Middle East நாடுகள் தங்கள் பொருளாதாரத்தை நவீனமயமாக்க மின்னணு விலைப்பட்டியல் (e-invoicing) முறைகளை விரைவாகச் செயல்படுத்தி வருகின்றன. SunTec Business Solutions நிறுவனத்தின் Sudheer Padiyar, இந்த மாற்றம் ஒரு சாதாரண ஒழுங்குமுறை விதிமுறை மட்டுமல்ல, இது ஒரு முக்கியமான டிஜிட்டல் உருமாற்றம் என்று குறிப்பிடுகிறார். கட்டண முறைகளை டிஜிட்டல் மயமாக்குவதன் மூலம், இப்பகுதியின் நிறுவனங்கள் சிறந்த செயல்பாட்டுத் திறன், நிதி வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை மற்றும் உலகளாவிய டிஜிட்டல் பொருளாதாரத்தில் சிறந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பை அடைகின்றன.

title: Centology’s Joe Power on ending re-keying in financial advice

Information captured in a portal is still downloaded, checked and typed again into a CRM, and then again later in the advice journey. Joe Power, Chief Operations...

content: Centology, represented by Chief Operations Officer Joe Power, is addressing the ongoing inefficiency of re-keying data within financial advice firms. Despite the shift to digital portals, many firms still manually transfer client information between systems multiple times. Power emphasizes the need to modernize these underlying workflows to replace repetitive data entry, ultimately streamlining the advice process and improving operational productivity for advisory businesses across the industry.
content_ta: நிதி ஆலோசனை நிறுவனங்களில் தரவுகளை மீண்டும் மீண்டும் பதிவு செய்யும் (re-keying) சிக்கலுக்கு Centology நிறுவனத்தின் தலைமை செயல்பாட்டு அதிகாரி Joe Power தீர்வு காண முயற்சித்துள்ளார். டிஜிட்டல் முறைக்கு மாறிய பிறகும், பல நிறுவனங்கள் வாடிக்கையாளர் தகவல்களை வெவ்வேறு மென்பொருள்களில் கையேடாகவே உள்ளீடு செய்கின்றன. இந்தச் சுழற்சியை மாற்றி, தரவு உள்ளீட்டு முறையை நவீனப்படுத்துவதன் மூலம் பணித்திறனை மேம்படுத்தலாம் என்று அவர் வலியுறுத்துகிறார்.

title: Mastercard’s Busy Week Tops Last Week’s Product Releases and Partnerships
summary: SoFi, Mastercard partner on card payment stablecoin settlement The system connects blockchain-based settlement and established card infrastructure. Stablecoins will settle transactions within the normal card experience. Moov Money built on Visa, Mastercard rails Moov Money enables consumers to send and receive money through their existing... Read More
content: Mastercard has had a productive week, highlighted by a new partnership with SoFi to integrate blockchain-based stablecoin settlement into established card payment infrastructure. This system aims to streamline transaction processing while maintaining a familiar card user experience. Additionally, Moov Money continues to expand its reach by leveraging both Visa and Mastercard payment rails to facilitate consumer money transfers, further bridging the gap between traditional banking and digital asset systems.
content_ta: Mastercard இந்த வாரம் மிகவும் பரபரப்பாக இயங்கி வருகிறது. குறிப்பாக SoFi நிறுவனத்துடன் இணைந்து, பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் (stablecoin) மூலம் கட்டணங்களைச் செலுத்தும் புதிய முறையை Mastercard அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இது சாதாரண கார்டு பரிவர்த்தனைகளைப் போலவே எளிமையாக இருக்கும். அதேபோல், Moov Money நிறுவனம் Visa மற்றும் Mastercard ஆகியவற்றின் கட்டமைப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தி வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்குப் பணப் பரிமாற்ற வசதிகளை வழங்கி வருகிறது. இது பாரம்பரிய வங்கிச் சேவை மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் தொழில்நுட்பத்தை இணைக்கும் முயற்சியாக அமைந்துள்ளது.

Tokenized capital markets-க்கான உள்கட்டமைப்பு தீர்வுகளை உருவாக்குவதில் Doppler Finance ஈடுபட்டுள்ளது, இந்த புதிய பட்டியல் திட்டத்தின் வளர்ச்சிக்கு ஒரு முக்கிய மைல்கல்லாகும்.

title: BitMine adds 17K ETH as Ethereum eyes a Q4 breakout against Bitcoin

title: Jamie Dimon Says the Dollar Only Stays Dominant if the US Makes Trade Deals

content: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon recently highlighted the importance of strategic trade agreements for maintaining the global dominance of the US dollar. He emphasized that the currency's reserve status is closely linked to the economic strength and international partnerships of the United States. According to Dimon, proactive trade policies with allies are essential to ensuring the dollar remains the primary global currency amidst evolving economic landscapes.
content_ta: JPMorgan நிறுவனத்தின் CEO Jamie Dimon, அமெரிக்க டாலரின் உலகளாவிய ஆதிக்கத்தைத் தக்கவைக்க மூலோபாய வர்த்தக ஒப்பந்தங்கள் மிக முக்கியம் என்று வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளார். அமெரிக்காவின் பொருளாதார வலிமை மற்றும் சர்வதேச நட்பு நாடுகளுடனான உறவுதான் டாலரின் இருப்பு நிலையை தீர்மானிக்கிறது என்று அவர் குறிப்பிட்டார். மாறிவரும் பொருளாதார சூழலில், டாலர் தொடர்ந்து முதன்மை நாணயமாக நீடிக்க, நட்பு நாடுகளுடன் ஆக்கபூர்வமான வர்த்தகக் கொள்கைகளை வகுப்பது அவசியம் என்று அவர் கூறினார்.

content: Wall Street is exploring the potential of tokenizing equities to modernize traditional stock trading infrastructure. content_ta: Wall Street பாரம்பரிய பங்கு வர்த்தக கட்டமைப்பை நவீனப்படுத்த பங்குகளை டோக்கனைஸ் (tokenization) செய்யும் முயற்சியில் ஈடுபட்டுள்ளது. title: Abracadabra proposes winding down MIM at four cents on the dollar
summary:

content: Abracadabra has announced a proposal to wind down the MIM stablecoin, offering a redemption value of four cents on the dollar. This move highlights significant stability issues within decentralized finance ecosystems. Drawing on more than 300,000 responses across 4,646 UK ATMs, the research found that ATMs influence repeat visits, with more than half (56%) visiting the shop more often because it has one, 76% more likely to return and 63% regularly using the same machine.
These visits translate into spend. Over one third (37%) said they would spend the cash they withdrew in-store, while 31% said withdrawing cash leads them to spend more. Applied to the £1.35 billion dispensed across 5,300 NCR Atleos ATMs in major convenience stores and supermarkets in June 2026, that suggests around £499.5 million was spent in-store, underlining the commercial value of having an ATM there.
Neil Martin, Managing Director at NCR Atleos UK, Ireland, Benelux, Baltics and Nordics, said: “Physical retail has always been about more than the transaction at the till. An ATM is not simply a piece of equipment in the corner of a store. It is the connective tissue between consumers, retailers and local services. That creates an important role for retailers, both in meeting a genuine customer need and supporting the economics of the store.
As deposit-capable ATMs become more widely available, these locations can support not only consumers accessing cash, but business owners looking for convenient ways to deposit their takings. The retail estate is already one of the UK’s most important pieces of physical infrastructure. How far that role extends into financial services will be an important shift to watch over the next few years.”
Having an ATM in these retail locations -supermarkets, convenience stores, forecourts - is also convenient for consumers visiting. 80% said they specifically came to withdraw cash, while 39% said withdrawing cash forms part of their shopping trip and 82% said having an ATM was convenient for their shopping.
Luke Ashton, Head of Operations, Gift Card and Cash Services, Asda Money said, “Customer choice is an important part of the retail experience. With more than 18 million shoppers visiting Asda each week, we want people to be able to access the services they need conveniently as part of their shop, including cash. For customers who choose or need to use cash, having an ATM on site provides a simple way to access it in a place they are already visiting. Making cash readily available across our stores helps us serve a wider range of customer needs, makes the shopping trip more convenient and gives customers greater choice in how they pay and manage their money.”
The role extends beyond the individual retailer, with 83% saying their local area would be worse off without the ATM.As deposit services develop alongside withdrawals, retail locations have the potential to become increasingly important points where cash both enters and leaves the system, serving consumers and small businesses while making better use of places people already visit.
The findings are published in a new whitepaper by NCR Atleos, Cash means business: How ATMs drive footfall, spend and loyalty for retailers.

title: Mastercard Partners with Mojaloop and AfricaNenda on Trusted Payments to Bolster the Instant Economy Across Africa
summary:
As countries across Africa continue to modernize their payment infrastructure, Mastercard is expanding its efforts to help build trusted and inclusive payment systems through strategic collaborations with The Mojaloop Foundation and AfricaNenda Foundation.   
Africa now has 36 live instant payment systems across 31 countries, processing more than 64 billion transactions worth close to US$2 trillion in 2024 alone1.  
As account-to-account payments continue to grow, the new partnerships will help to strengthen local payments infrastructure enabling consumers and businesses to transact safely and confidently, fuelling economic growth across the continent. 
Through a new collaboration with The Mojaloop Foundation, a non-profit that maintains free, open-source payments software and community infrastructure, Mastercard will explore how its AI-powered A2A Protect solution can complement Mojaloop's, payment infrastructure to help strengthen fraud prevention and deliver end to end consumer protections that more closely mirror the safeguards consumers have come to expect from cards.  Bringing together real time risk scoring, mule account intelligence and dispute resolution services in a single framework, Mastercard A2A Protect is one of the industry’s most comprehensive solutions for account to account payment protection, helping financial institutions combat fraud whilst fostering trust and accelerating the adoption of instant payments at scale. 

Mojaloop’s technology has already been used to roll out deployments across Africa3, where Mojaloop has supported the development of interoperable payment infrastructure.  
Mastercard has also partnered with AfricaNenda Foundation, an Africa-based non-profit dedicated to accelerating financial inclusion through inclusive instant-payment systems. By combining Mastercard's real-time payments expertise with AfricaNenda's regional policy engagement and governance support, the organizations are helping advance interoperable, trusted and resilient payment systems across the continent, helping bring more people, businesses and communities into the digital economy.  
Mastercard's work with Mojaloop and AfricaNenda reflects a shared ambition – to help shape the future of Africa's digital economy through instant payment systems that are not only fast and interoperable, but also safe, inclusive, and trusted. 
Johan Gerber, Executive Vice President, Payment Networks said: “Trust is the foundation of every successful digital economy. As account-to-account payments accelerate across Africa, consumers and businesses need the confidence that their money is protected and supported when something goes wrong. We’re excited to work with Mojaloop and AfricaNenda to bring our A2A expertise and enhanced consumer protections to help unlock Africa’s instant payments future.” 
Jean Bosco Iyacu, Chief Executive Officer, The Mojaloop Foundation commented: “Mojaloop provides free, open-source payment infrastructure that enables countries to deploy instant payment systems quickly and cost-effectively. We are seeing first-hand how these systems are transforming the way consumers in underbanked communities move money, but adoption depends on trust and strong protection when it is needed. Mastercard’s fraud prevention and dispute resolution capabilities can strengthen protection and give consumers greater confidence in using digital payments. By adding these options alongside open source solutions to our framework, and with the continued support of our partners and community, we are helping make financial inclusion across Africa a reality.

title: Experian Launches Cashflow Attributes for Commercial Lenders
summary:
Experian® today announced Experian Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders, a new solution that transforms business bank transaction data into analytics-ready attributes to help financial institutions make more informed decisions and gain a deeper understanding of the financial health of the businesses they serve.
“Small businesses are a vital part of our economy and helping them access the credit they need to grow and expand starts with providing lenders with a more complete understanding of their financial health,” said Molly Poppie, Chief Product and Analytics Officer for Experian Financial Services and Data. “Commercial credit data is critical to understanding business risk, and Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders adds another powerful dimension by providing an automated and current view of how a business is operating. By pairing these insights, we can help lenders make more-informed decisions and power more opportunities for small businesses to thrive.”
Experian’s announcement comes as access to capital remains critical for small businesses looking to operate and grow. According to the Federal Reserve Banks’ 2026 Small Business Credit Survey,1 60% of small businesses sought financing in the prior 12 months, most commonly to meet operating expenses (56%) or pursue an expansion or new business opportunity (46%). Yet just 42% of applicants received all the financing they sought, while more than 1 in 5 received none.
At the same time, lenders need sufficient information to confidently evaluate a business's financial health and ability to repay. For businesses with limited commercial credit histories, traditional credit information alone may not provide a complete picture. Cash flow insights can provide an additional view into how a business is operating and its overall financial health, helping lenders make more-informed decisions and identify opportunities to responsibly extend credit to more businesses.
Experian’s preliminary analysis shows Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders are particularly useful for businesses with thin credit files, providing up to a 24% lift in predictive performance when paired with traditional commercial credit data.
“At a time when decision-making, especially using AI, is becoming a significant competitive differentiator, Experian Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders makes particular sense,” said Jerry Silva, vice president, IDC Financial Insights. “Modern decision platforms need access to multiple alternative data sources, and having commercial transaction information will give those institutions that leverage it a competitive leg up.”
Turning business transactions into actionable insights
Leveraging first-party transaction data, such as information from an institution’s existing business checking account relationships, or permissioned commercial bank account transaction data, Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders provides insight into a business’ financial health, including predictive analytics on liquidity, revenue trends, operating expenses, debt exposure and repayment capacity.
Designed to complement Experian’s commercial credit data, more than 500 analytics-ready attributes can be used across underwriting, portfolio management and model development to help lenders quickly integrate cash flow into their workstreams.
Continuing Experian’s investment in cash flow insights
The launch reflects Experian’s continued investment in expanding its cash flow capabilities across consumer and commercial markets and expands the company’s existing commercial credit data and analytics capabilities by adding transaction-based signals to lending decisions.
Experian Cashflow Attributes for commercial lenders leverages technology from Slope, a specialist in business decisioning and commercial bank account data, selected by Experian to help accelerate the delivery of commercial cash flow capabilities to clients.
“We're excited to collaborate with Experian to help bring richer cashflow insights to commercial lenders,” said Lawrence Lin Murata, co-founder and CEO of Slope. “Small businesses generate valuable financial signals through their daily operations and banking activity. By combining Slope's expertise in transforming business transaction data with Experian's industry-leading commercial credit data and analytics, we're helping lenders gain a deeper understanding of business performance and create more opportunities for small businesses to access the capital they need to grow.”

title: Moneybox Enhances Investment Offering with New Ready-Made Actively Managed Funds with Lowest-Ever Service Fee
summary:
Moneybox, the award-winning wealth management platform, has enhanced its investment offering with the launch of three new ready-made, actively managed Moneybox funds, available with its lowest-ever service fee.
The new Moneybox Cautious, Balanced and Adventurous Funds are offered in partnership with and actively managed by experts at Amundi, the largest European investment manager.
Each fund offers customers a ready-made portfolio aligned to a different level of investment risk, designed to make it easier to start and stay invested without having to choose and manage individual investments themselves.
Customers simply choose the Moneybox fund that best reflects their appetite for risk, while Amundi’s investment experts manage the portfolio on their behalf.
The new funds are available through Moneybox investing accounts, including its Stocks & Shares ISA, where investment growth and income are free from UK capital gains tax and income tax, subject to ISA rules.
Customers investing in one of the new Moneybox funds will pay an annual 0.15% Moneybox service fee, the lowest service fee the company has offered to investing customers.
Combined with the 0.29% fund fee, service and fund fees total 0.44% a year — equivalent to £4.40 for every £1,000 invested.*
Moneybox’s 0.45% service fee continues to apply to other investments available through the platform.
Moneybox is also removing its £1 monthly subscription fee for customers with £5,000 or more across qualifying investing and savings accounts.
Together, the changes are designed to make investing simpler and better value, whether customers are taking their first steps into investing or already have investments elsewhere and are reviewing their options and costs.
Jay Swanston, Chief Platform Officer at Moneybox, said:
“Investing can feel unnecessarily complicated, particularly when you’re getting started. Many people know they want to make more of their money over the long term but are put off because they don’t know what to invest in or feel they need to become an expert first.
“Our new Moneybox funds are designed to make that decision much simpler. Customers choose the fund that best reflects the level of risk they are comfortable with, and the experts at Amundi take care of managing the investments from there.
“We also know that cost matters when you’re investing over the long term. That’s why these funds come with our lowest-ever service fee of just 0.15%, helping customers keep more of their money invested and working towards their goals.
“Whether you’re investing for the first time or already investing elsewhere, we want Moneybox to offer a simple, reassuring way to build wealth with confidence.”
Three ready-made funds
Customers can choose from three actively managed options:
Moneybox Cautious Fund — designed for customers looking for a more cautious approach to investing.
Moneybox Balanced Fund — designed for customers seeking a balance between potential long-term growth and investment risk.
Moneybox Adventurous Fund — designed for customers comfortable taking greater investment risk in pursuit of higher potential long-term growth.
The funds are expertly curated and actively managed by Amundi, meaning customers do not need to select individual investments or continually manage their portfolio themselves.
Customers opening a Moneybox Stocks & Shares ISA can be presented with the Moneybox fund range as part of the account-opening journey, which can be completed in around two minutes.
The launch builds on Moneybox’s growing wealth-building proposition and its partnership with Amundi, following the introduction of three Moneybox pension funds earlier this year.
Originally launched as a round-up investing app in 2016, Moneybox now supports customers across saving, investing, home-buying and retirement.

title: Kora Adds Stablecoin Payments for African Merchants Through One Rail
summary:
Kora, a pan-African payment infrastructure provider, today announced the launch of One Rail, expanding its payments infrastructure to support stablecoins. Through One Rail, merchants can seamlessly collect, hold, convert, and settle funds in digital currencies alongside traditional fiat payment rails.
African businesses operating across borders face persistent structural challenges, including slow international settlement times, high foreign exchange conversion costs, limited access to USD liquidity, and fragmented infrastructure across markets. One Rail directly addresses these pain points by allowing merchants to leverage stablecoins and settlement networks to accelerate cross-border value transfer while reducing operational complexity.
With the US dollar serving as the dominant currency for much of Africa’s cross-border commerce, Kora’s initial support will include USDT and USDC – with additional major USD-backed stablecoins to be added based on demand and regulatory and operational readiness.
As an extension of Kora’s core infrastructure, One Rail is designed for teams without technical blockchain expertise. Developers can seamlessly access stablecoin support through the same Kora APIs and developer tools they already use. 
The integration allows merchants to access dedicated wallet generation to receive stablecoin payments seamlessly, complete with real-time tracking and automated payment reconciliation through the primary Kora Dashboard. Additionally, businesses can manage their liquidity by holding digital dollar balances or converting them into supported local fiat currencies, which can then be settled directly into local bank accounts via Kora’s established payout rails.
"Cross-border commerce in Africa is hindered by high friction and remittance costs averaging 8–8.8% compared to the 6.49% global average. At the same time, stablecoin ownership in Africa is now at 78%," said Dickson Nsofor, CEO and Founder of Kora. "At Kora, we provide the financial infrastructure connecting Africa to the world’s digital economy. One Rail levels the playing field, enabling merchants to integrate stablecoin payments into their existing payment stack, delivering the speed, cost efficiency, and access needed to drive business growth across the continent.”

title: ThetaRay Appoints Former TMX and Instinet Executive Laure Richmond as Chief Financial Officer
summary:
ThetaRay, a global leader in AI-native financial crime compliance (FCC) infrastructure, today announced the appointment of Laure Richmond as Chief Financial Officer. Bringing over two decades of financial leadership across institutional trading, and financial technology, Laure Richmond will lead ThetaRay’s global finance organization, capital allocation, and operational scaling. 
Laure Richmond joins ThetaRay amidst accelerating global regulatory mandates. In the US, provisions under the GENIUS Act establish strict BSA/AML and real-time transaction screening obligations for digital assets and payment issuers. In Europe, the EU AI Act’s strict rules for high-risk AI in financial services mandate transparent, audit-ready compliance platforms. As financial institutions replace legacy rules-based systems with mission-critical AI, Laure Richmond will oversee the financial strategy supporting ThetaRay’s rapid global growth and market expansion.   
Laure Richmond brings extensive experience driving global financial strategy, regulatory compliance, and scaled operations for tech-driven financial platforms. She previously served as CFO at TMX VettaFi and TMX Datalinx, leading financial strategy for the data and analytics division of TMX Group. Prior to TMX, she spent nearly two decades at Instinet (a Nomura subsidiary), where she served as Global CFO. 
Based in New York, Laure Richmond works across ThetaRay’s global footprint, bridging financial discipline with product innovation, commercial execution, and client success. 
"With regulatory shifts turning explainable AI into core infrastructure, scaling globally requires both discipline and sharp execution," said Brad Levy, CEO of ThetaRay. "Laure’s proven track record across major financial technology platforms and her hands-on approach make her the partner we need to drive our capital strategy and lead industry innovation and consolidation.” 
“ThetaRay is defining the future of financial crime compliance through agentic AI," said Laure Richmond, CFO of ThetaRay. "Spending time on the ground with our teams in Tel Aviv, London, Madrid, and New York confirmed the immense opportunity ahead. My focus is on pairing capital strategy with product innovation to expand our platform capabilities and capitalize on strategic growth opportunities."

title: BMLL and Simudyne Partner to Power AI Market Simulation with High-Fidelity Historical Data
summary:
BMLL, the leading independent provider of harmonised, continually engineered historical Level 3, 2 and 1 data and analytics for Capital Markets, today announced a partnership with Simudyne, an advanced generative AI and agent-based simulation platform designed to model and replicate market dynamics. 
The collaboration will combine BMLL's L2 and L3 harmonised historical order book datasets with Simudyne's advanced Pulse simulator, used specifically for intraday markets, to enable market participants to run highly realistic, reactive market simulations, perform market replays and test system performance.
Transitioning to AI-Driven Simulation: Training AI models on BMLL’s tick-level data
Simudyne is an established leader in the development of market simulation software, built around methods such as agent-based modelling, which relies on proprietary behavioural assumptions for market participants, and other machine learning techniques. Simudyne is now pre-training  state-of-the-art generative models of intraday order flow using the same techniques as underpinning language AI models, such as ChatGPT. Because these next-generation AI models do not rely on hand-crafted expert rules, their realism is strictly determined by the quality and volume of the data they are fed.
Under this partnership, Simudyne has begun training generative AI 'Large Market Models', using granular market data, enabling synthetic tick-data generation and client-specific fine-tuning alongside its established rule-based agent-based modelling capabilities. The resulting simulator goes beyond traditional, static historical replay to offer ‘reactive’ back-testing, meaning the simulated market dynamically responds and adapts to the user's executed orders in real-time.
Empowering the Ecosystem: Pre-training Advanced AI Models with Definitive Level 2 and Level 3 Data
The integration of BMLL’s granular historical data and Simudyne’s AI-powered market simulation engine will deliver critical simulation capabilities across the entire Capital Markets ecosystem. 
Algo traders & quants can test, optimise, and refine execution algorithms in a simulated market that dynamically responds to their trading activity (reactive back-testing) rather than static historical replay. Quants can also leverage Simudyne's calibrated models and BMLL's datasets as a benchmark to optimise and train their own machine learning execution models.
Execution & TCA analysts can simulate large orders prior to actual execution to estimate slippage, transaction costs, and market impact, helping to select optimal order routing strategies and study how other simulated participants react to their orders.
Trading technology teams can connect staging and testing systems directly to the simulated exchange (via FIX connectivity or APIs) to validate system performance, latency, and end-to-end trading software setups under highly authentic, reactive conditions.
Exchanges can safely test and validate modifications to matching engine logic, trading protocols, and new order types against a faithful simulator replica before deploying to production. This enables risk-free prototyping of new auction mechanics, circuit breakers, and fee structures.
Risk & clearing teams can run highly complex liquidity risk calculations, matching the advanced risk analysis, and stress-test margin, clearing, and default-fund models against a broad range of simulated volatility events and market regimes.
Paul Humphrey, Chief Executive Officer of BMLL, said: "We are delighted to welcome Simudyne to our BMLL Activate Data Credits Programme. High-quality training data is the single most critical ingredient for sophisticated, AI-driven financial modelling. By hosting Simudyne’s simulation models directly within the BMLL Data Lab, we will be able to give our clients a safe, highly realistic sandbox to run reactive simulations on top of our definitive historical order book. Ultimately, this collaboration serves as a powerful proof-of-concept, establishing BMLL data as the premier foundation for firms to train their own AI models, while reinforcing our ongoing commitment to driving the next wave of innovation across global Capital Markets.”
Justin Lyon, Chief Executive Officer of Simudyne, said: "We are very excited to collaborate with BMLL to push the boundaries of market simulation. As we move towards data-driven, generative AI models, simulation fidelity is only as strong as the data underpinning them. BMLL’s granular, high-resolution historical market data gives our models the depth needed to learn and reproduce real market dynamics at the order-book level. Together, we are creating the next generation of market simulation environment that bridges historical market behaviour and realistic synthetic markets.”
Partnership Anchored in Simudyne's Participation in the 'BMLL Activate' Data Credits Programme
The partnership is enabled by Simudyne’s participation in the 'BMLL Activate - Data Credits Programme', an initiative designed to help partners build, test, and launch new analytics or data-driven solutions on top of BMLL's historical Level 3, 2, and 1 market data.
The program accelerates product development and market validation by offering lower to no upfront data licence costs during the build phase. Under the program, selected partners receive a defined allowance of BMLL data credits redeemable for structured access to the BMLL Data Lab and the BMLL Data Feed. 
This enables Simudyne to build, train, and host its generative foundation models and multi-agent market simulation software, creating a seamless path from research and validation to commercial adoption for joint clients.

summary:
The Uranium Finance case shows how prosecutors allege crypto from two exploits moved through Tornado Cash into high-value collectibles.
The post Pokemon Crypto Case: Collector Faces Trial Over $55 Million Hack appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: A collector is facing trial in connection with a major cryptocurrency hack involving millions of dollars. Prosecutors allege that digital assets stolen during exploits were funneled through the mixing service Tornado Cash and used to purchase high-value collectibles, including rare Pokémon items. Legal proceedings are moving forward as authorities continue targeting illicit crypto laundering methods.
content_ta: மில்லியன் கணக்கான டாலர்கள் மதிப்பிலான கிரிப்டோ ஹேக் வழக்கு தொடர்பாக ஒரு சேகரிப்பாளர் விசாரணையை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளார். சுரண்டல்களின் போது திருடப்பட்ட டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் Tornado Cash என்ற மிக்சிங் சேவை மூலம் மாற்றப்பட்டு, அரிய Pokémon பொருட்கள் உள்ளிட்ட மதிப்புமிக்க சேகரிப்புகளை வாங்குவதற்குப் பயன்படுத்தப்பட்டதாக வழக்கறிஞர்கள் குற்றம்சாட்டுகின்றனர். சட்டவிரோத கிரிப்டோ பணமோசடி முறைகளை அதிகாரிகள் தொடர்ந்து குறிவைத்து வருவதால் சட்ட நடவடிக்கைகள் முன்னெடுத்துச் செல்லப்படுகின்றன.

title: MEXC Leads SOL and DOGE Market-Price Liquidity in CoinGecko’s 2026 CEX Report
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 30, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, led the exchanges studied in order book liquidity at the market price for both SOL and DOGE in CoinGecko Research’s 2026 Crypto Liquidity on CEXes Report. The report measured order book depth for the top five non-stablecoin assets, BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and DOGE, across eight exchanges over 60 days from July 6 to September 3, 2026.   MEXC Records Highest SOL Liquidity at the Market Price CoinGecko found that SOL liquidity was more evenly distributed across exchanges in 2026 compared with the previous year. Within this more competitive landscape, MEXC recorded approximately $934,000 in SOL order book liquidity at the market price, the highest among the eight exchanges studied.   The report also noted that SOL liquidity became more distributed across exchanges despite overall liquidity declining from 2025 levels. Beyond the immediate market price, other venues gained depth, with Bitget and Coinbase overtaking MEXC past the ±$0.20 range.   MEXC Leads DOGE Liquidity at the Market Price and Further Out For DOGE, MEXC recorded more than $443,000 in order book liquidity at the market price, the highest among the exchanges studied. Only Binance, MEXC and OKX exceeded $200,000 at this level.   Further from the market price, MEXC regained the lead past the ±$0.0006 (0.3%) range, surpassing Binance and Bitget. Its liquidity then leveled off beyond the ±1% interval at roughly $2 million on each side of the order book.   MEXC Maintains Deep DOGE Liquidity During Market Shifts The report also examined DOGE liquidity during individual market events. On August 21, as DOGE market depth shifted alongside broader price movements, MEXC remained among the venues showing substantial depth across the order book. The report’s observations also found that MEXC traders placed larger block orders around key price levels during subsequent DOGE price movements.   “For retail traders, liquidity is fundamental to market quality. It determines execution efficiency, price stability and the ability to enter or exit positions with confidence,” said Vugar Usi Zade, CEO of MEXC. “Deep liquidity is therefore central to how MEXC lowers barriers to trading and provides more efficient access to global market opportunities.”   Taken together, the findings show MEXC maintaining strong liquidity close to the market price for both SOL and DOGE, while its DOGE depth also extends further into the order book. For traders, deeper liquidity can support more efficient execution by allowing orders to be absorbed with less impact on market prices.   Looking ahead, MEXC will continue to strengthen market depth and execution quality as part of its broader effort to provide users with a more efficient trading experience under its “Infinite Opportunities” vision.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com Source Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions.
content: CoinGecko Research’s 2026 CEX Report has named MEXC as a leading exchange for market-price order book liquidity in SOL and DOGE. According to the report, MEXC recorded the highest market-price liquidity among studied exchanges for both SOL and DOGE, showcasing strong execution efficiency and deep market depth. MEXC executives emphasized the platform's ongoing commitment to lowering trading barriers and providing efficient access for retail users worldwide.
content_ta: CoinGecko-வின் 2026 CEX அறிக்கையானது SOL மற்றும் DOGE மார்க்கெட்-பிரைஸ் ஆர்டர் புக் லிக்யூடிடியில் MEXC-ஐ முன்னணி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சாக பெயரிட்டுள்ளது. ஆய்வுக்கு உட்படுத்தப்பட்ட எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சுகளில் MEXC மிக உயர்ந்த லிக்யூடிடியைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளதாக அந்த அறிக்கை சுட்டிக்காட்டுகிறது. சில்லறை வர்த்தகர்களுக்கு சிறந்த வர்த்தக அனுபவத்தை வழங்குவதில் உறுதியாக இருப்பதாக MEXC நிறுவனத் தரப்பு தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

EPAM நிறுவனத்தின் பொறியியல் நிபுணத்துவமும், Domino-வின் ஒருங்கிணைந்த தளமும் இணைந்து நிறுவனங்களுக்கு GxP-சரிபார்க்கப்பட்ட AI மாதிரிகளை வரிசைப்படுத்தவும், புள்ளிவிவரக் கணினிகளை நவீனமயமாக்கவும் உதவுகின்றன.

title: Experian Expands Its Range of Services in Snowflake to Help Businesses Unlock the True Value from Their Customer Data
summary:
Experian, the global data and technology company, today announces the expansion of its capabilities within Snowflake, the AI Data Cloud company, with the launch of two new Snowflake Native Apps. The services will empower organisations to improve the quality of their customer contact information and create audience segments for paid media campaigns using their own existing customer data.
Customers can natively access these capabilities within Snowflake's AI Data Cloud, helping to keep data secure and within the organisation’s control, as well as strengthen privacy and compliance protections. This includes:
Contact Data Validation: Organisations can efficiently validate, standardise and enrich physical addresses, email addresses and phone numbers directly within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, helping improve campaign reach and customer engagement, reduce failed deliveries and communications, and strengthen the quality of data used for analytics and AI.
Audience Activate: Businesses can connect their own customer data to a range of digital identifiers required for marketing channels. With 85% digital connectivity to UK households, Audience Activate helps organisations reach more of their customers across more touchpoints, improving the relevancy, efficiency and performance of paid media campaigns.
By removing the need to transfer customer data outside their Snowflake environments, Audience Activate helps organisations reduce complexity, accelerates audience activation, while ensuring data remains protected, governed and fully under their control.
Andrew Abraham, Global Managing Director, Experian Data Quality, said: “In today's data-driven world, businesses need confidence that the data powering their customer engagement, analytics and AI strategies is accurate, actionable and trusted.
“Experian is constantly innovating to help businesses overcome data challenges and unlock new opportunities. We're excited to deepen our relationship with Snowflake and help organisations improve the quality of their data where it already lives, reach the right audiences, and turn trusted data into better customer and business outcomes."
Colin Grieves, Managing Director, Experian Marketing Services UK&I, said: "Businesses want to unlock more value from their existing customer data, but when it comes to activating across paid media, there’s often a gap between the customer data they own, and their ability to turn it into actionable audiences across digital marketing channels. With Audience Activate, we're helping businesses bridge the gap in a simpler, faster and privacy-conscious way.
"Brands can connect their customer data to channel-relevant identifiers and build and deploy audiences to advertising platforms without moving customer data outside their Snowflake environment, giving them the ability to scale digital reach, improve marketing efficiency and deliver growth, all whilst maintaining strong data governance and control."
The integrations are the latest between Experian and Snowflake. Earlier this year, Experian announced Aperture Data Studio’s integration with Snowflake, giving organisations the ability to profile, transform and validate data directly within the Snowflake platform.
Experian is a sponsor of the Snowflake World Tour, taking place at ExCeL London today (September 30th). In the panel session, How to Turn Customer Data into Actionable Intelligence, Experian will discuss how businesses can unlock greater value from their data, build trust in their insights and engage customers more effectively.
A free trial of the Contact Data Validation app is available today; interested organisations are encouraged to request access. The app will be available globally via the Snowflake Marketplace later this year. Audience Activate is currently in Beta testing with a select group of customers, and will be available to UK businesses from January 2027.
NoYesData30 Sep, 2026
content: Experian has expanded its offerings within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud by launching two new Snowflake Native Apps: Contact Data Validation and Audience Activate. These tools allow businesses to improve data quality and create audience segments for marketing campaigns directly within their Snowflake environments. The integration helps organizations enhance data privacy, security, and compliance while unlocking more value from their existing customer data without needing to transfer it externally.
content_ta: Snowflake AI Data Cloud-ல் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ள Experian நிறுவனம், Contact Data Validation மற்றும் Audience Activate ஆகிய இரண்டு புதிய Snowflake Native Apps-களை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த கருவிகள் மூலம் நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் Snowflake சூழலிலேயே தரவு தரத்தை மேம்படுத்தி, மார்க்கெட்டிங் பிரச்சாரங்களுக்கான பார்வையாளர் பிரிவுகளை உருவாக்க முடியும். தரவை வெளியில் மாற்றாமல் பாதுகாப்பான முறையில் வாடிக்கையாளர் தரவிலிருந்து கூடுதல் பலன்களைப் பெற இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு உதவுகிறது.

title: Bitget hackers move $4 million into Zcash’s private pool, making funds harder to trace
summary: Three transfers pushed about 15% of the stolen ZEC into Ironwood, where payments hide their senders, recipients and amounts.
content: Hackers responsible for the Bitget exploit have moved approximately $4 million into Zcash’s private pool. Through three separate transactions, about 15% of the stolen ZEC funds were transferred into the Ironwood shielding pool. This action obscures the transaction details, making the senders, recipients, and amounts significantly harder for investigators to trace.
content_ta: Bitget ஹேக்கர்கள் திருடிய சுமார் $4 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான தொகையை Zcash-ன் பிரைவேட் பூல்-க்கு மாட்டியுள்ளனர். மூன்று தனித்தடுத்த பரிமாற்றங்கள் மூலம், திருடப்பட்ட ZEC தொகையில் சுமார் 15% Ironwood பகுதிக்கு மாற்றப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கையானது அனுப்புபவர்கள், பெறுபவர்கள் மற்றும் தொகையின் விவரங்களை மறைத்து, அவற்றை கண்டறிவதை மிகவும் கடினமாக்குகிறது.

title: The SEC Is finally modernizing transfer-agent rules. Wall Street must not repeat the ‘paperwork crisis’
summary: If ownership data is split across a token wrapper, a special-purpose vehicle (SPV), a broker’s internal ledger and a transfer agent's off-chain database, we are setting the stage for a Paperwork Crisis for the blockchain age, argues Fairmint’s Joris Delanoue.
content: The SEC is updating transfer-agent rules, prompting warnings from industry experts like Fairmint's Joris Delanoue. As ownership data spreads across blockchain token wrappers, SPVs, broker ledgers, and off-chain databases, Wall Street must avoid triggering a modern 'paperwork crisis' akin to historical challenges by unifying and modernizing these fragmented record-keeping systems.
content_ta: SEC transfer-agent விதிகளை நவீனப்படுத்தி வருகிறது, இது Fairmint-ஐச் சேர்ந்த Joris Delanoue போன்ற நிபுணர்களின் எச்சரிக்கைக்கு வழிவகுத்துள்ளது. பிளாக்செயின் token wrapper-கள், SPV-கள், broker ledgers மற்றும் off-chain databases ஆகியவற்றில் உரிமைத் தரவுகள் பரவி வருவதால், Wall Street நிறுவனம் வரலாற்றுச் சவால்களைப் போன்ற நவீன 'paperwork crisis'-ஐத் தவிர்த்து, இந்தச் சிதறிய பதிவேட்டு முறைகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்க வேண்டும்.

content_ta: McDonald's நிறுவனம் தனது வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் எவ்வளவு பணம் செலுத்த தயாராக இருக்கிறார்கள் என்பதை மதிப்பிட்டு அதற்கேற்ப விலையை நிர்ணயிக்க செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு அடிப்படையிலான 'Pricing Engine' முறையைப் பயன்படுத்துவதாக ஒரு புதிய செய்தி வெளியாகி உள்ளது. இந்த இயந்திரக் கற்றல் (machine-learning) மாதிரிகள் ஒவ்வொரு உணவகத்திலும் உள்ள பொருட்களுக்கு உகந்த விலையைத் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன. இதனால், சில மைல் தூர இடைவெளியில் உள்ள கிளைகளுக்கு இடையே கூட உணவுப் பொருட்களின் விலையில் வித்தியாசங்கள் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: PXP Partners with OKTO Payments to Offer Locally Operated Latin American Payment Rails
summary:

The rails are connected directly to domestic infrastructure and operated locally by OKTO in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Argentina and beyond.
PXP processes €35bn+ annually and has built its proposition on one connection into online, mobile and point-of-sale commerce, backed by in-house acquiring and a broad alternative payment method portfolio. This partnership with OKTO enables PXP to support LatAm merchants and end-users with expanded domestic payment methods and infrastructure, overcoming the complexity and varying regulations that span these markets.

For PXP’s merchants, the partnership covers more than acceptance. Instant pay-ins and payouts on domestic rails sit alongside local card processing, advanced treasury and liquidity management, and settlement in a single layer. We have built local banking relationships, local depth and compliance capability in each market we operate, and we pair that with product depth engineered in-house — instant pay-ins and payouts on domestic rails, treasury and liquidity management, settlement and reconciliation in one layer. PXP's merchants get all of it, seamlessly."
Andre Boesing, General Manager South LatAm, OKTO PAYMENTS

Through this partnership, one connection into PXP will offer domestic payment methods, instant pay-ins and payouts, and treasury and liquidity management connected directly to local infrastructure across LatAm. We’re very excited for what this will enable for our merchants and to be collaborating with OKTO. "

title: Sumsub Agentic AI Council Launches in APAC and Invites Experts to Advance Trusted AI Adoption
summary:
Cross-sector leaders will develop practical guidance on responsible use cases, trustworthy technical foundations and workable guardrails for agentic AI
Sumsub, the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale, today announced the launch of the Sumsub Agentic AI Council (the “Council”), an APAC-focused cross-sector forum that convenes expertise to develop practical frameworks, advance shared best practices and inform responsible agentic AI adoption.
The Council is now calling for leaders and experts from policy, academia, technology, industry and civil society to express interest in participating as founding Council advisors. By bringing together cross-sector perspectives, the Council will examine the real-world conditions needed to deploy agentic AI responsibly, including identity, delegated authority, security, transparency, accountability and oversight.
AI agents are rapidly evolving from experimental tools into systems capable of planning, making decisions and taking actions on behalf of individuals and organizations. Emerging use cases such as agentic commerce illustrate their growing real world impact, with Deloitte reporting that nearly three-quarters of APAC consumers already use AI to discover, compare, and research products. Meanwhile, 95% of businesses are already using or piloting multi-step AI systems with limited human input. Yet, recent incidents have demonstrated how AI systems can operate beyond their intended scope or take unexpected actions, underscoring the importance of accountability, transparency and human oversight. Across APAC, the common challenge is to unlock the value of autonomous AI while ensuring it can be trusted, controlled and deployed responsibly.
Regional policy and standards initiatives signal growing recognition of the opportunities and considerations associated with agentic AI.  Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI, Mainland China's efforts to develop standards for AI agent identity and interoperability, Hong Kong's 2026 Policy Address proposal for cross-sector AI agent safety-management guidelines, and the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong (SFC)'s exploration of new guidance on the use of AI agents in the financial services sector signal the same trend. However, as the agentic AI landscape continues to evolve rapidly, practical insights from businesses and technical experts will be equally important in informing how agentic AI is deployed at scale, governed and trusted in practice.
Building on its expertise across verification, fraud prevention and compliance, Sumsub has developed AI capabilities that support both the use and governance of AI agents, including the platform-native AI assistant, Summy AI Copilot; Know Your Agent (KYA) framework;  and MCP integration capabilities. These developments reflect Sumsub’s focus on building trust and accountability in the emerging AI ecosystem. Recognizing the need for greater cross-sector dialogue, Sumsub is launching the Council to bring together diverse perspectives and translate discussion into actionable recommendations for industry and policymakers.
“The opportunity presented by agentic AI is becoming clearer with every new use case, but the conditions for responsible adoption in environments with real financial, operational and regulatory consequences are still taking shape, even as they become increasingly business-critical,” notes Jason Chan, APAC Government Relations Lead at Sumsub. “Drawing on our work helping organizations build trust and accountability in digital interactions, we have a front-row view of these challenges and see an opportunity to accelerate trusted and scalable AI adoption with the Sumsub Agentic AI Council.”
Bridging Innovation, Infrastructure and Accountability in Agentic AI
Through its three pillars—Adopt, Build and Govern—the Council will translate insights into outputs, including guidance on responsible AI adoption, research and industry reports, stakeholder dialogues and thought leadership initiatives.
Adopt: Explore responsible and impactful applications of agentic AI across the digital economy, including compliance, fraud prevention, customer experience and operational efficiency.
Build: Advance the technical and operational foundations required for trustworthy AI agents, including agent identity, verifiable credentials, secure architectures, traceability and interoperability.
Govern: Address the policies, standards and accountability mechanisms needed as AI systems gain greater autonomy, helping clarify responsibilities and develop practical governance approaches.
“The conversation around AI often begins with capability. Sustainable adoption, however, will depend not only on what these systems can do, but also on how confidently organizations can deploy and govern them,” emphasized Mick Amelishko, AI Advocate at Sumsub. “The Council will create a platform where experts from different disciplines can share perspectives and help advance approaches that support the responsible development of agentic AI.”
Calling for Experts to Contribute to the Next Phase of Agentic AI Adoption
Founding advisors will contribute to workstreams across the Adopt, Build and Govern pillars, helping develop a practical framework covering AI agent identity, delegated authority, interoperability and auditability. The Council’s first working group is expected to focus on agentic commerce, exploring the identity, accountability, and oversight considerations that may arise when AI agents act on behalf of consumers and businesses.

title: Trading Technologies Acquires TRAFiX, Expanding Multi-Asset OEMS Coverage to Global Equities and Equity Options
summary:
Trading Technologies International, Inc. (TT), a global capital markets technology provider, today announced it has acquired TRAFiX LLC (TRAFiX), a leading provider of equities and equity options order and execution management systems (OEMS) and FIX connectivity solutions. The addition of TRAFiX will make TT one of the most comprehensive multi-asset trading platforms in capital markets technology, extending its coverage across every major asset class—from futures, foreign exchange (FX) and fixed income to global equities and equity options—on a single, cloud-native platform.
Terms of the transaction, which closed today, were not disclosed.
This acquisition builds on TT’s long-standing market leadership in futures and options execution and the launch of the firm’s fixed income, FX and cryptocurrency offerings. The integration of TRAFiX’s market-leading OEMS capabilities for global equities and equity options will create a single, end-to-end global multi-asset trading platform offering best-in-class execution management system (EMS) and order management system (OMS) tools; comprehensive FIX and market connectivity; multi-asset risk management, analytics and regulatory reporting; multi-asset trade surveillance and compliance workflows; and multi-asset pre-trade and intra-day margin analytics.
The enhanced TT platform will enable customers to replace fragmented legacy vendor stacks with a modern, cloud-native trading architecture. It will help them unify and simplify risk management with capital efficiency across all asset classes in real time; automate workflows and seamlessly execute innovative cross-asset trading strategies; and expand venue access through a single connectivity layer reaching key liquidity providers worldwide across exchange-traded and over-the-counter (OTC) products.
Justin Llewellyn-Jones, CEO of Trading Technologies, said: “This acquisition is transformational for TT and represents a significant step forward in our multi-asset evolution. With TRAFiX fully integrated into the TT platform, clients will have access to a single, cloud-native system delivering unparalleled cross-asset trading capabilities. TRAFiX has built an exceptional product and talented team, trusted by more than 200 customers globally, with connectivity to more than 100 trading venues. Together, we are creating something truly differentiated for our customers that will redefine the capital markets landscape.”
Walter Fitzgerald, Co-Founder and CEO of TRAFiX, said: “Our team is thrilled to bring TRAFiX into the Trading Technologies family, and even more excited about what this means for our customers. We have built a next-generation equities and equity options trading platform that seamlessly unites order and execution management to meet the dynamic demands of today's global trading desks. Our platform empowers broker-dealers, asset managers and proprietary trading firms with low-latency execution, real-time data visibility and robust compliance tools, all within a single unified workflow. By joining forces with Trading Technologies, we are taking our solution to the next level, combining our cutting-edge equities and options capabilities with TT's global scale to deliver the ultimate multi-asset trading platform.”
